title: Swim: technique
detail: Technique: 200 easy, then 8-12 x 50 drill/swim (catch-up, fingertip drag, side kick), 4 x 25 breathing every 3, 200 easy. Rest as needed; form over distance.

title: Bike: intervals
detail: Cadence and sweet spot: 15 min easy, 3 x 8 min at 88-93% FTP (cadence 90+) with 4 min easy, 10 min easy.

title: Run: easy
detail: Easy aerobic run, conversational (Z2). Soft surface where possible. 6 x 20 s relaxed strides at the end.

title: Strength A
detail: Knee rehab A: Spanish squats 3 x 45 s, Bulgarian split squats 3 x 8 per side, single-leg RDL 3 x 8, step-downs 3 x 10, side plank 3 x 30 s.

title: Swim: main set
detail: Endurance: 200 easy, 10-14 x 100 steady with 20-30 s rest. Hold form; stop the set if it falls apart. 100 easy.

title: Run: easy
detail: Easy aerobic run, conversational. Soft surface. Stop early if the knee complains.

title: Bike: easy spin
detail: Easy Z1-Z2 spin, cadence 90-100. Flush the legs; include 4 x 30 s high-cadence spin-ups.

title: Strength B
detail: Hip and glute B: hip thrusts 3 x 10, banded clamshells 3 x 15, lateral band walks 3 x 12, single-leg calf raises 3 x 15, dead bugs 3 x 10.

title: Long ride
detail: 75 min Z2 endurance ride (65-75% FTP). Steady, fueled, no surges. Practice eating 60 g carbs per hour.

title: Long run
detail: 45 min easy aerobic run (Z2). Build the knee's tolerance to time on feet; walk breaks are fine.
